description: This source file defines a configuration class for interacting with XAI's Responses API. It extends existing OpenAI response configurations to accommodate XAI-specific behaviors, such as unsupported parameters, tool transformations, and environment validation. The class provides methods to map parameters, validate environment setup, and construct API endpoint URLs.

classes.name: XAIResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for XAI's Responses API, extending OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig with XAI-specific behaviors such as parameter support, tool transformations, and environment validation.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the provider type, specifically indicating XAI.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI response parameters, excluding 'instructions' which XAI does not support.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, response_api_optional_params: ResponsesAPIOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Transforms the provided parameters to be compatible with XAI, removing unsupported parameters and modifying tools (especially code_interpreter) to remove the 'container' field and adapt to XAI requirements.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Validates and sets up necessary headers for API authentication, pulling API keys from parameters, environment secrets, or environment variables.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the XAI Responses API endpoint based on input parameters and environment variables.
